Sora2.prompt: A tense Dutch angle handheld shot with organic camera shake in a dilapidated ancient Chinese room at night. A sharp three-foot sword blade dominates the foreground, its cold steel gleaming with blue-tinged candlelight as it points directly at a terrified young Chinese woman in pale green hanfu pressed against a crumbling wall. On the left, a pale young man with cold phoenix eyes sits in a wheelchair, his black robes merging with the shadows as he steadily holds the sword. The camera wobbles nervously with irregular micro-movements, gradually pushing closer while the Dutch angle intensifies from 15 to 20 degrees. The woman's wide fearful eyes glisten with forming tears, her hands raised defensively near her throat. Cold blue candlelight creates harsh dramatic shadows, with occasional warm flickers. The atmosphere is thick with life-or-death tension. The sword remains steady as a visual diagonal line cutting through the frame. Ancient Chinese anime style, cinematic psychological thriller, highly detailed, 8K quality.
